intro: Lesson 70: Dual bar charts. To understand how to read and interpret dual bar charts

blocks.text: Label both axes, choose a scale, and draw the bars with a ruler, with gaps between them.

questions.model: Teacher: find April, the Year 6 bar, read across: 38.

questions.q: Total books for Year 5 over 4 months; for Year 6
Which month had the biggest difference between the years?
Write 2 statements comparing the years, one using 'more' and one using 'total'.
questions.a: For example Year 6 read more in 3 of 4 months; Year 6 read 134 in total, 17 more than Year 5

questions.q: A dual bar chart needs a... A) key B) pie C) line
Big question: how can one chart compare two groups?
questions.a: Two bars side by side for each category, with a key
